observations: Whole scan and both halves viewed first, then C and H. Thirteen broad enlarged regions cover all text and diagrams. Close crops checked every ambiguous symbol and C doubt, including corrected crop boxes when the first crop missed its target. Slanted margin rotated upright; cancellations enlarged and deskewed; watermark rotated and tonal range expanded. All frames, connecting strokes, overwritten starts and live insertions included. No context read and no recognition software used.
